cbi_real_estate_threshold_2026.note: Citizenship by Investment real estate threshold. Confirmed unchanged on invest.gov.tr — historical figure was $250,000. Genuinely distinct from the $200,000 residence-only property threshold below; several tier-3 sites conflate the two.

cbi_other_categories_threshold_2026.note: Citizenship by Investment threshold for all non-real-estate categories: fixed capital, bank deposit, government bonds, investment/pension-fund shares. Each requires a 3-year hold period.

residence_only_property_threshold_2026.note: Property-based residence permit (non-CBI) minimum value, effective since 16 October 2023. Yields residence ONLY, not citizenship — a genuinely distinct product from the CBI real-estate route despite both being property-based. Best-documented on tier-3 sites and Ministry of Interior circulars rather than a single clean tier-1 English page.
